message: An AI receptionist that answers in Saudi Arabic, built in under two minutes, booked a dentist on the first call

lines.text: I built an AI receptionist that answers the phone in Saudi Arabic, and it took me less than two minutes.
You sign up on Voho, create an agent, and give it Layla, a warm Najdi voice that sounds like a local.
Then you write its instructions in Saudi Arabic: book the appointment, take the patient's name and number, and never give medical advice.
I pressed call and asked for a dentist tomorrow afternoon, and it booked me in. Fifty seconds, six cents.
That's a receptionist that picks up every call. Comment CLINIC and I will send you the link.
